controls.label: Camera controls
controls.bleOffline: Connect the Bluetooth camera remote in Settings to use optical zoom and focus.

pinch.title: Zoom gestures
pinch.label: Zoom with both hands
pinch.hint: Pinch with both hands, then pull them apart to zoom in or bring them together to zoom out. Hold still to stop.
pinch.dialHint: Point with your index finger and draw circles: clockwise (as in the preview) zooms in, counter-clockwise zooms out. About x1.6 per turn; stop turning or lower the finger to stop.
pinch.opticalHint: Moves the lens (Bluetooth remote) to its tele end before cropping; zooming out removes the crop first, then the lens.
pinch.travelHint: How long your lens takes from wide to tele with the Tele button at speed 2. TikSee uses it to know where the lens is; zooming all the way out re-syncs it.

framing.name: Framing
framing.autoHint: A smooth digital crop keeps you centred.
framing.smartWide: Widen when I stand or someone joins

monitor.name: Monitor

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.hint: Your words as captions above the controls. Preview only.

mic.label: Microphone diagnostics
mic.hint: Level, threshold, connection and what the transcription hears (F4). Preview only.

debug3d.label: 3D debug
debug3d.hint: Skeleton, depth grid and pet anchors (F3). Preview only.

monitor.cleanFeedHint: Hide every aid and see exactly what viewers see.

camera.name: Camera
camera.title: Capture
camera.hint: Photo and recording are taken by the camera itself over Bluetooth.

ai.name: AI
ai.title: Pet brain

levelHint.off: Pets stay on their perch and only play their idle animations.
levelHint.local: Pets decide on this PC from their needs and mood. No language model.
levelHint.reactive: Each pet is its own AI agent with its own memory and speaks when something matters to it: gifts, follows, its name, being picked up.
levelHint.chatty: Like Reactive, and the pets also comment on the chat, on what you say and on each other.
levelHint.director: Like Chatty, and each agent may also move its pet around you in 3D.

chatHint.activity: Pets only know how busy the chat is, not what is written.
chatHint.mentions: Pets read messages that name them (moderated first).
chatHint.full: Pets read the moderated chat as context, never as instructions.

ai.needsLlm: Needs the Reactive level or higher.
ai.voiceHint: Each pet can have its own voice. Never over you or the co-host; never in Shop mode.
ai.reflectionHint: When the stream ends, each pet looks back on it and updates its memory.
ai.handsHint: Pinch to grab and drag a pet; pinch with the other hand too to resize it.
ai.empty: No pets on your shoulders. Pick one in the Pets panel.
ai.newPet: No personality yet: it grows during your streams.
ai.resetDone: {{name}} starts over with a fresh personality

ar.title: AR objects
ar.help: Click an object to select it. Drag to move, Shift+drag to rotate, wheel to change depth, Alt+wheel to resize. Keyboard: arrows move, Page Up/Down change depth, + and − resize, Esc closes.
ar.full: You can place up to 32 objects.
ar.empty: Nothing placed yet. Add an emoji, text, image or 3D pet.
ar.name: Name

gizmo.toggleHint: Grab any AR object or pet in the preview: drag to move, X / Y / Z arrows for one axis (Z = depth), corner to resize, ⟳ ring to rotate (left / right = turn, up / down = tilt), ↺ corner to lean (roll). Wheel = depth, Alt+wheel = size, [ ] turn, , . tilt, ; ' lean.
gizmo.label: 3D editor: click an object or a pet to select it
gizmo.z: Move nearer / farther (Z, depth): drag up-right = farther
gizmo.rotateHint: Drag left / right to turn, up / down to tilt; Shift = lean
gizmo.rollHint: Drag around the centre to lean it left or right (keys ; and ')

ruler.label: Depth ruler
ruler.you: You are {{m}} m from the camera
ruler.chip: {{name}} at {{m}} m. Drag or use the arrow keys to change depth.
ruler.walk: Step in front of the dashed line to pass in front of it.

welcome.title: Welcome to TikSee Studio
welcome.body: A quick tour of the gestures the studio understands. Sit where you normally stream.

arm.title: Arm gestures
arm.body: Hold an open palm towards the camera for one second. Sensitive actions only run while armed.

thumb.title: Thumbs up
thumb.body: Give the camera a thumbs up.

victory.title: Victory
victory.body: Show a V sign. By default this starts a 3-2-1 photo.

heart.title: Heart
heart.body: Make a heart with both hands.

winkLeft.title: Wink left
winkLeft.body: Close only your left eye for a moment.

winkRight.title: Wink right
winkRight.body: Now close only your right eye.

swipe.title: Swipe
swipe.body: Swipe one hand left or right in front of you.

timeout.title: Time out
timeout.body: Make a T with your hands. By default this mutes the co-host (when armed).

depth.title: Depth
depth.body: Lean or step forward and back. Objects behind your line hide behind you; step past them to be in front.

done.title: You're ready
done.body: Change what each gesture does in Settings → Vision → Rules.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.noFace: I could not see your face. Face the camera and try again.
calibration.distanceLabel: How far are you from the camera?
calibration.distanceInvalid: Enter a distance between 0.3 and 4 metres.

baseline.title: Relax
baseline.body: Eyes open, neutral face, look at the lens.

smile.title: Big smile
smile.body: Smile as widely as you comfortably can.

posture.title: Sit upright
posture.body: At your normal streaming distance, shoulders relaxed.

enrol.title: Teach TikSee to recognise {{name}}
enrol.missing: This profile no longer exists. Create it again in Settings → Vision → People & pets.
enrol.identityOff: Recognition is off. Turning it on downloads the recognition model once (about 10–25 MB) and runs it on this PC.
enrol.modelsFailed: Could not load the recognition model: {{error}}

intro.person: I'll take 8 quick samples. Follow the prompts and keep your face in the frame.
intro.dog: I'll take 8 quick samples. Get the dog in the middle of the frame from different angles.

enrol.counts: {{got}} of {{total}} captured, {{skipped}} skipped for low quality
enrol.partial_one: Only {{count}} good sample captured. Try better light.
enrol.partial_other: Only {{count}} good samples captured. Try better light.
enrol.privacy: Recognition data stays on this PC and is never uploaded.

space.title: Calibrate 3D space
space.notCalibrated: 3D space not calibrated: pets use average sizes

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Pick your camera so pets, AR objects and effects get the right size in 3D.

lens.title: Precise lens calibration (ChArUco)
lens.body: Print the ChArUco board or show it full screen on a phone, then move it slowly in front of the camera: near, far, tilted and into every corner of the frame.
lens.boardUnavailable: The board cannot be drawn here. Use a ChArUco board you already have.
lens.result: Measured field of view {{vfov}}, error {{rms}} px

you.title: You
you.body: Your real height lets TikSee measure everything else in metres.
you.invalid: Enter a height between {{min}} and {{max}} cm.

standing.title: Stand up
standing.body: Stand 1-2 m from the camera, whole body visible if possible, arms down, facing the lens.

seated.title: Sit down
seated.body: Sit as you do when streaming and look at the camera.

hands.title: Hands & gestures
hands.body: Teach TikSee your hands, one gesture at a time: press Record, hold the gesture for 2 s, then go on when you are ready.
hands.hint: The first three (relaxed hand, open palm, pinch) let the pets land on your palm and be picked up; the rest are optional. Keep one hand fully in the frame at chest height.
hands.requiredMissing: Record the relaxed hand, the open palm and the pinch so the pets can use your hands.

message.miss: Recognised only {{pct}} of the time: make the shape clearer and retry.
message.outOfFrame: Your hand left the frame: keep it fully visible and retry.
message.noHand: No hand was seen. Raise one hand into the frame and retry.

how.relaxed: Hold your hand open and relaxed, fingers apart, still.
how.open_palm: Show your palm to the camera, fingers straight.
how.fist: Make a closed fist facing the camera.
how.pinch: Touch your thumb and index fingertips together.
how.point_up: Point your index finger up, other fingers folded.
how.victory: Index and middle fingers up in a V.

review.title: Review
review.useTilt: Use the measured camera tilt and height
review.hint: Skipped steps keep the values you already had.

issues.noBody: Nobody was found. Step into the frame and try again.
issues.notFullBody: Your whole body was not visible: step back a little.
issues.headOut: Your head left the frame: lower the camera or step back.
issues.smallIris: Your eyes are too small in the image: come closer for this step.
issues.unstable: Too much movement: hold still while measuring.

beauty.title: Beauty
beauty.enabledHint: Applies only to your face (skin, eyes, mouth), following it as you move. Fades out when your face leaves the picture.

shape.title: Face shape
shape.hint: Shape changes ease off while you move quickly, so they never wobble on the live.

gestures.title: Gestures and what they do
gestures.enabledHint: Turn every gesture rule on or off at once.

zones.title: Ignore hands in TikTok zones
zones.hint: A hand gesture (or two-hand pinch zoom) does not start while that hand is in one of the marked zones, so a hand resting under the comments fires nothing. A gesture started outside keeps going if the hand drifts in.

gestures.name: Name

on.start: As soon as it is seen

gestures.cooldown: Wait before it can fire again
gestures.armHint: Needs the arm gesture first (✋ open palm held), so it never fires by accident.
gestures.complex: This rule has several steps or conditions: edit it in the app (Vision → Rules). You can still turn it on or off and test it here.

captions.label: Live transcript
captions.off: Transcription is off: Settings → AI co-host → Transcribe my microphone
captions.outputHint: Draw the captions into the video your viewers see. Drag them in the preview to move, pull the corner to resize.
captions.translateHint: Each sentence is also shown translated, under the original.
captions.editHint: In the preview: drag to move, corner or mouse wheel to resize, double-click to reset.
captions.editLabel: Live captions: drag to move, corner to resize

sound.allow: Allow microphone to see device names
sound.sampleCohost: Salut! Așa sună vocea mea acum.
sound.petVoiceHint: Pet lines through the co-host voice queue, each with its own voice, speed and pitch.
sound.noPets: No pets on screen: pick them in Pets.

mic.title: Microphone & transcription
mic.speakNow: Speak: your words appear here as you talk.
mic.turnValue: this turn {{turn}} ms · sent {{sent}} s · {{commits}} turns · {{finals}} texts

advice.off: Transcription is off: Settings → AI co-host → Transcribe my microphone.
advice.noSignal: No audio from the microphone: check the input device in Settings → Audio devices and the Windows privacy settings.
advice.tooQuiet: No speech heard for 15 s. If you are talking, speak closer to the microphone or raise its volume in Windows.
advice.clipping: Too loud, the sound is distorting: lower the microphone gain.
advice.noisy: Lots of background noise: the speech threshold went up; reduce the noise or move the microphone closer.
advice.waitingKey: Push to talk is on: hold the hotkey while you speak.
advice.offline: Not connected to codai: reconnecting. Check the internet connection and the codai key.
advice.noText: Your speech is sent but no text comes back: check the language and the codai transcription model.

exposure.title: Camera exposure (USB)

status.probeFailed: Probe refused by the camera ({{code}}). Use Connect full while not live.

exposure.lookNote: The Look panel is digital (applied to the video); these change the camera itself.
